name: memory-tools
description: Captures every Write or Edit into agent memory or auto memory with a PostToolUse hook, one YAML record per call under ${XDG_STATE_HOME:-~/.local/state}/memory-tools/<host>/<owner>/<repo>/, and grades what it captured for a checkout with the read-only /memory-tools:memory-grade skill: delete, durable, or no code home, each with its evidence or its destination.
